1374-3626-5499-8296--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-8296--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

953-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
953-8266.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to draw your library and put a card from your hand on top of your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to draw two cards and then win the game.

1671-2645-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
1671-2645-3430-5475.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2438-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2438-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-4210-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-4210-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Pious Evangel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5478-5531-5694-7487-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5478-5531-5694-7487-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
5478-5531-5694-7487-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Zealous Lorecaster and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

6034-6733-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
6034-6733-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
6034-6733-8089.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1636-4499-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures, three of which are Elves excluding Thranduil that do not have summoning sickness.
1636-4499-7892.description:
Activate three Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking a creature you control.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4499-7892.notes: If you happen to control an Elf that has haste, you can perform the combo only controlling three Elves and blink the Elf with haste each loop. Otherwise, you can blink Thranduil or any other creature that isn't tapping for mana.

2893-3470-6763-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-2653-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1090-1594-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-2999-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2999-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2079-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2079-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-1879-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-1879-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

147-2292-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

321-392-399-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-3899-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1021-1315-2034-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-1315-2034-6761.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-1315-2034-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

2724-3080-5299-6568.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

2438-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2438-5972-6054.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3470-5226-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
3470-5226-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student // Tamiyo, Seasoned Scholar

708-4050-4948-6223.notablePrerequisites: Estrid's Invocation on the battlefield as a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-4050-4948-6223.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tamiyo, adding {U}.
Choose to return Tamiyo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Tamiyo from the command zone by paying {U}.
Repeat.

1170-2499-4124-5478-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

967-3101-5258-5618-6131.manaNeeded: {B} plus an amount of {R} equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin
967-3101-5258-5618-6131.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ignot Chewer for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ingot Chewer enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, destroying target artifact.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to sacrifice Ingot Chewer.
When Ingot Chewer dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Ingot Chewer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger from step 7, causing you to exile the top five cards of your library, including Ingot Chewer, with the ability to play those cards until end of turn.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ingot Chewer from exile for its evoke cost by paying {R}.
Prosper and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Prosper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

1116-3240-5070-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5070-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

323-2577-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1812-2092-5685.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
1812-2092-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {G}.
Repeat.

575-5231-5624.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Nervous Gardener, adding {R}.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1409-1418-2208.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-1418-2208.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve both Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

565-2450-3908.notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
565-2450-3908.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting any Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
Orvar, Spark Double and the Spark Double token trigger, creating three token copies of the Island.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Island tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time to get infinite untapped Island tokens and blue mana.
If you choose to get infinite mana, you can then target any permanent using Whim of Volrath to get infinite tokens of them.

594-1926-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Crab" chosen with Species Specialist.
594-1926-2034.description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
When the Crab dies, Species Specialist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

696-2751-2816-2872.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least six charge counters on it.
Umbral Mantle attached to Clever Conjurer.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
696-2751-2816-2872.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Clever Conjurer by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
104-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

57-232-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-2178-4050.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding one mana of any color.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

1376-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Priest of Titania.
You control at least two Elves.
1376-3263-3525.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

193-1543-1940-4772.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional planeswalker.
Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters on it.
193-1543-1940-4772.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Liliana.
Liliana enters the battlefield with twelve loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on Aminatou and Liliana.
Activate Liliana by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
